SUB-LEASE OF WAREHOUSE UNIT
Sample agreement · not a real contract
L1 · Kloof Storage (Pty) Ltd (sample) Page 1 of 2
1. PARTIES
1.1 This sub-lease is entered into between Kloof Storage
(Pty) Ltd (sample) (“the Sublessor”) and Marula Office
Supplies (Pty) Ltd (“the Sublessee”).
2. PREMISES
2.1 The Sublessor sub-lets to the Sublessee Unit 12, Kloof
Business Yard, Pinetown (“the Premises”), for use as a
warehouse and storage area only.
2.2 The Sublessee shall not use the Premises for any
unlawful purpose, and shall not store hazardous or
flammable goods there without the written consent of
the Sublessor.
2.3 The Sublessee shall keep the Premises clean and in
good order, and shall report any damage to the roof,
doors or electrical installation to the Sublessor without
delay.
3. DURATION
3.1 This sub-lease commences on 1 August 2026 (“the
Commencement Date”).
3.2 The initial term is 24 (twenty-four) months from the
Commencement Date.
3.3 The Sublessee shall take occupation on the
Commencement Date and shall vacate on the last day
of the sub-lease, leaving the Premises empty and in the
condition in which it received them, fair wear and tear
excepted.
4. RENT AND DEPOSIT
4.1 The monthly rent is R18 500.00 excluding VAT, payable
in advance on or before the first Business Day of each
month, without deduction or set-off.
4.2 The rent escalates by 7% (seven percent) on each
anniversary of the Commencement Date.
4.3 The Sublessee shall pay a deposit of R37 000.00 on
signature of this sub-lease.
4.4 Any amount not paid on its due date bears interest at
the prime rate plus 2% (two percent), calculated daily
from the due date until the date of payment.

5. RENEWAL AND CANCELLATION
5.1 This sub-lease renews automatically for successive
periods of 12 (twelve) months unless cancelled in terms
of clause 5.2.
5.2 Either party may cancel this sub-lease by giving the
other not less than 90 days written notice before the
renewal date.
6. GENERAL
6.1 This sub-lease is the whole agreement between the
parties. No variation of it is of any force unless it is in
writing and signed by both parties.
6.2 No relaxation or indulgence granted by either party is a
waiver of any right, and no such relaxation may be
relied on as a precedent.
6.3 The parties choose as their addresses for all notices
the addresses given at the head of this sub-lease. A
notice sent by email is treated as received on the next
Business Day.
6.4 If any clause of this sub-lease is found to be invalid, the
rest of it remains in force. This sub-lease is governed by
the law of the Republic of South Africa.
6.5 The Sublessee shall insure its own goods kept on the
Premises against loss by fire, theft and water damage,
and shall give the Sublessor a copy of the policy
schedule on request.
6.6 The Sublessor may enter the Premises at any
reasonable time on reasonable notice to inspect them
or to carry out repairs, and in an emergency without
notice.
6.7 Each party bears its own costs of preparing this
sub-lease. The Sublessee bears the costs of any
registration of it that the Sublessee requires.
6.8 The Sublessee shall not cede its rights or sub-let any
part of the Premises without the prior written consent of
the Sublessor.
